title: Storage Design for Stateful Applications knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the central idea of “Storage Design for Stateful Applications”?
options: Assume edits in the container writable layer are durable application storage.
Remove every unused volume as part of each normal restart.
Store application state inside the image at build time.
Use a managed named volume when data should outlive a replaceable container.
questions.answer_key: Use a managed named volume when data should outlive a replaceable container.
questions.explanation: Docker-managed volumes can survive container replacement and are suited to persistent data; backups and restores still need verification.

questions.prompt: For a lab covering storage design for stateful applications, what is the strongest evidence of learning?
options: Make several unrelated changes before collecting a baseline.
Use a production host so the result looks realistic.
Record the command or configuration, predicted result, observed evidence, and one relevant edge case.
Assume the command is portable and skip reading its output.
questions.answer_key: Record the command or configuration, predicted result, observed evidence, and one relevant edge case.
questions.explanation: A useful lab connects a predicted result to actual output and checks an edge case. This is safer and more reproducible than assuming success.

questions.prompt: If an example related to storage design for stateful applications fails, which response is best?
options: Trust the image tag without inspecting the image or version.
Reproduce the issue, inspect state/logs/configuration, test one hypothesis at a time, and verify the fix.
Delete every stopped container and unused volume before investigating.
Disable permissions or security controls until the example works.
questions.answer_key: Reproduce the issue, inspect state/logs/configuration, test one hypothesis at a time, and verify the fix.
questions.explanation: The evidence-led approach keeps the diagnosis reproducible and avoids hiding the cause. For storage design for stateful applications, verify the fix with the exact setting or command that failed.
